Terms and Conditions of Silesia 5K RUN 2026
Terms and Conditions of Silesia 5K RUN 2026
§1. Organiser
1. Silesia Marathon Foundation is the Organiser of Silesia 5K RUN. 2. The Marshal Office of the Silesia Voivodship is the co-organisers of the races and the organisation partner is the cite of Chorzow.
§2. Date and place. The Route. 
1. Race will take place on October 2nd, 2026. 2. The race will begin at 18:00 (the start time may be subject to change). 3.The race will take place within the Tauron Park Śląski area and its exact route will be presented on the official website: silesiamarathon.pl 4. The routes length is 5 km. 5. Participants of the race are required to follow the instructions of the Police, City Guard and other people securing the route..
§3. Participation (terms and charges)
1.Participation in the race is not subject to any age restrictions. Participation of minors requires registration and completion of all required data in the registration form by a legal guardian, as well as downloading and completing the consent form by the legal guardian. The completed written consent form (template available for download) must be submitted at the Race Office when collecting the starter pack. If the consent form is not provided, the starter pack will not be issued. Participants under the age of 16 may start only when accompanied by adult legal guardians who are registered participants. 2. The condition for participation in the race is: a) acceptance of these Terms and conditions and the provisions contained herein, as well as a commitment to comply with them. b) acceptance of the declaration confirming the absence of medical contraindications to participate in the race by selecting the appropriate checkbox during the race registration process. 3. The participant limit for the race is 5,000 people. 4. The entry fee in Silesia 5K RUN 2026 is: a) PLN 59 – before March 15th, 2026 b) PLN 69 – before July 5th, 2026 c) PLN 79 – before September 13th, 2026 (in the case of available starter packages the registration deadline may be extended) The Organizer will inform about the possible number of available starter packs no later than  September 15th. 5. The right to a discounted entry fee for the race is granted to: a) participants who will not have reached the age of 16 on the day of the event – a fixed entry fee of PLN 59 until September 13th 2026. b) participants who will have reached the age of 70 on the day of the event – a fixed entry fee of PLN 59 until September 13th 2026. 6. The date of payment is determined by the date of receipt of funds on the organizer’s account. 7. The registration fees are subject to change. Any new fee adjustments will not affect participants who have already paid before the changes were implemented. 8. In the event of insufficient payment of the entry fee (eg as a result of exceeding the payment deadline specified in these regulations), the competitor is obliged to pay the difference up to the amount he should have paid in accordance with the payment deadline specified in the regulations. 9. A previously purchased voucher for the same race may be used for registration and assignment of a race number, in accordance with the applicable voucher purchase regulations (until August 31th 2026). 10. Payments are made by individually generated electronic transfers in cooperation with imoje: with  Visa, Visa Electron, MasterCard, MasterCardElectronic, Maestro, Płatności online, Płatności mobile BLIK, Przelew tradycyjny, PayPo, twisto, Blik płacę później, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Visa Mobile. 11. VAT invoices are issued only by the 15th day of the month following the month of payment of funds to the organizer’s account, provided that the request for an invoice is sent electronically (contact form >>> Invoices and payments) along with complete information on the complete necessary data to issue it and to provide the date of payment. 12. The entry fee can not be transferred to another competitor. 13. The registration fee is non-refundable and non-transferable to the following year and another distance. According to Article 38 point 12 of the Consumer Rights Act (Act of May 30, 2014, on Consumer Rights, Dz.U.2020.0.287), participants do not have the right to withdraw from the agreement for the provision of services related to entertainment, sports, or cultural events if the specific day or period of service provision is indicated in the agreement. 14. In the event of any irregularities in the payment process, a complaint must be submitted electronically using the contact form. The Organizer is responsible for handling the complaint. The complaint review process will begin within no more than 2 business days from the date of submission and will be completed within 14 days from the date of submission. All correspondence in this regard will be conducted electronically (contact form >>> Invoices and payments). 15. All participants of the race receive a BIB number.
§4. Entry and collection of a Race Pack
1. Registrations for the race are accepted using the registration form available on the website https://events. silesiamarathon.pl/ – until September 13th, 2026, or until the limit of spots is filled. 2. Confirmation of registration and payment of the entry fee is the assigned race number. The assignment of the race number may take up to 5 business days. Registrations without completed payment and an assigned race number will be deleted after 7 days. 3. Collection of starting numbers and packages will be possible in person or by a designated person at the Race Office after presenting a ticket with a QR code on the following days: October 1th, 2026 from 17:00  – 20:00. October 2nd, 2026 from 17:00  – 20:00. The opening hours and days of the Race Office may change, and the Organizer will provide updates accordingly. Tickets with a QR code will be sent on September  29-30 to the telephone number and e-mail address provided during registration. 4. If the participant’s starter package is collected by other people, it is required to provide this person with a ticket with a QR code, which the person will present at the Race Office. 5. The organizer, for safety reasons, reserves the right to implement additional verification of participants by requesting them to present Identity Card or Passport 6. The location of the Race Office will be announced at a later date. 7. Starter packages can only be collected during the specified days and hours as stated in the Terms and Conditions. The organizer does not offer shipment of starter packeges, and uncollected starter packeges are forfeited.
§5. Measurement and time limits.
1. Time measurement is carried out using an electronic system (a time measurement chip is built into the start number). 2. The official time of the competition is the net time (the time from crossing the start line to crossing the finish line). 3. During the race all competitors must have the starting numbers received in the package attached to the front of the starting jersey. Under the penalty of disqualification, it is unacceptable to cover the starting number in part or in whole, modify it or place it elsewhere than on the starting shirt. 4. The organizer sets the time limit for completing the race for 55 minutes chip time. 5. Remaining on the race course after the designated time as well as not following decisions made by the judges and event staff will result in the disqualification of the participant. 6. On the race course, assistance from cars, bicycles, scooters, and other vehicles outside of those provided by the organizer is prohibited.
§6. Ratings and prizes
1. The ratings in the  Silesia 5K RUN will be conducted in the following categories: a) general: men and women – by net time b) by age: men and women – by net time • W 20 from 18 to 29 years old • W 30 from 30 to 39 years old • W 40 from 40 to 49 years old • W 50 from 50 to 59 years old • W 60 – 60 years and older • M 20 from 18 to 29 years old • M 30 from 30 to 39 years old • M 40 from 40 to 49 years old • M 50 from 50 to 59 years old • M 60 from 60 to 69 years old • M 70 – 70 years and older
2. The general classification of women and men (places I-III) is decorated and awarded. 3. Awards in the general classification will be granted based on gun time. Gun time is calculated from the start of the first group. 4. The organizer reserves the right to introduce additional classifications. Additional classifications for social groups and professional groups will be conducted based on separate regulations. 5. Each participant who meets the participation requirements and completes the race within the time limit set by the Organizer will receive a commemorative medal. 6. Official results will be published on the website silesiamarathon.pl after any submitted protests have been reviewed and the Organizer has received the results of anti-doping control.
§7. Final Provisions
1. The participants are to observe the regulations of PZLA, World Athletics and the present Terms and Conditions. 2. The organizer may conduct anti-doping tests among selected participants. Refusal to participate in an anti-doping test or a positive test result indicating doping use will result in the disqualification of the participant from the race. 3. Participants are obliged to comply with public order, orders from the security services, and show respect to other race participants. 4. Participants are required, under penalty of disqualification, to maintain cleanliness along the race route. Specifically, littering cups, bottles, and used wrappings outside the designated refreshment zones is strictly prohibited. 5.The organizer has the right to remove from the route and event area individuals who disrupt public order, interfere with the course of the race, or not complay with the Terms and Conditions. 6. Not following the Terms and Conditions can be a reason for disqualifying of a participant. 7. Due to the recommendation of IOC and Word Athletic, competitors representing Russia and Belarus are excluded from the race. 8. The organizer provides participants with necessary medical care along the race route and at the finish line during the event. 9. Silesia 5K RUN is insured under general terms. Individual insurance against injuries or other unfortunate events that may happen to a participant during the race requires a separate insurance purchased individually by the participant. 10. Protests will only be accepted in written, paper form and will be received by the Competition Office until 20:00 on the day of the event. 11. Any complaints, remarks, or requests related to participation in the race may be submitted via the contact form within 3 days from the date of the event’s conclusion. Complaints will be reviewed within 30 days after the event. 12. Transferring BIB number to another person during the race or any part of it will result in the disqualification of the participant using that race number. 13. Staying on the race route without a valid BIB number or placing it anywhere other than the front of the start shirt is prohibited and will result in disqualification. Individuals without a valid BIB number will be removed from the route by the route staff. Specifically, it is prohibited to move along the race route on bicycles, roller skates, skateboards, or other mechanical devices, and to bring animals without valid permission issued by the Organizer. Participants using Nordic Walking poles are also not allowed. 14 By registering for the event, the participant accepts Terms and Conditions and agrees to the free use of their image captured in the form of photographs or video recordings. Additionally, they grant the Organizer a free license to use this image for various purposes, including those within the scope of copyright law, for the promotion and organization of events by the Silesia Marathon Foundation. This consent includes sharing with sponsors and partners of Silesia Marathon Fundation  for promotional purposes, publication in various media (such as websites, press, TV, and radio broadcasts), as well as in publications of the Silesia Marathon Foundation and promotional materials printed by the Organizer. 15. The Organizer is not liable for the cancellation of the event due to reasons beyond their control and unpredictable. 16. The Organizer reserves the right to make changes to the regulations during the event if the situation requires it for the safety of participants and organizers.
Chorzów,  January 20th 2026.
CONSENT FOR THE PROCESSING OF IMAGE
By registering, the participant consents to the processing by the Silesia Marathon Foundation, based in Chorzów at ul. Katowicka 10 (hereinafter: the “Foundation”), registered in the Register of Associations, Other Social and Professional Organizations, Foundations, and Healthcare Entities maintained by the District Court Katowice – East in Katowice, VIII Commercial Division of the National Court Register, under number 0001122701, of their personal data in the form of name, surname, email address, contact details, and image captured in photographs or video recordings, for the purpose of public presentation in television, radio, internet broadcasts, and promotion of events organized by the Silesia Marathon Foundation.
Furthermore, the participant declares that they have been informed that:
1. The administrator of their personal data is the Silesia Marathon Foundation, based in Chorzów at ul. Katowicka 10.
2. The basis for processing their data is this consent declaration, and providing the data is justified for the purpose of organizing races by the Silesia Marathon Foundation and promoting the events organized by the Foundation.
3. Personal data in the form of name, surname, and email address may be shared with other recipients or categories of recipients, i.e., official sponsors and partners solely for the purpose of co-organizing the races. The list of sponsors is available at: “Sponsors and Partners.”
4. The data covered by this declaration will not be transferred to non-EU countries where the entities referred to in point 3 do not comply with Regulation (EU) 2016/679. In the event of transfer to third countries, it will be carried out with appropriate safeguards as specified in Article 46 of the General Data Protection Regulation, and the participant will have the right to obtain a copy at the following location: Silesia Marathon Foundation Office, 41-500 Chorzów, ul. Katowicka 10.
5. The data will be stored until 31 December 2032.
6. After this period, the data will continue to be stored for purposes required by law (especially tax and accounting regulations), as well as for preventing fraud and abuse, and for pursuing any claims arising from the concluded agreement. Some data (particularly those included in race results) may also be processed after this date for statistical and archival purposes.
7. Providing the data covered by this declaration is voluntary but necessary to participate in the race.
8. The participant has the right to request access to their personal data, rectification, deletion, or restriction of processing, as well as to object to processing and to data portability.
9. The participant has the right to lodge a complaint with the Supervisory Authority if their personal data is processed in violation of applicable law.
10. The participant has the right to withdraw this consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out based on the consent prior to its withdrawal.
